# Catalyzing scientific impact through global partnerships and open resources

Published: 2026-05-01

Canonical link: <https://research.google/blog/catalyzing-scientific-impact-through-global-partnerships-and-open-resources>

Author: The Google Research Science team

Our approach to open science is built on responsible, inclusive, and rigorous research
so more teams can build on high-impact discoveries.

A scientific breakthrough reaches its full potential when other researchers can
replicate and extend the work.

## Partnerships and ecosystem collaboration

Google Research works with specialized institutions to expand access to tools,
datasets, and reproducible methods.

* Shared benchmarks and open datasets.
* Cross-disciplinary collaboration with research partners.
